translations.literal: Official Posts Treatise III ○ Southern Face
translations.idiomatic: Official Posts Treatise III — Southern Face

sentences.zh: 契丹國自唐太宗置都督、刺史，武后加以王封，玄宗置經略使，始有唐官爵矣。

translations.literal: From Emperor Taizong of Tang the Khitan state had commandery governors and prefects appointed; Empress Wu added princely enfeoffments; Emperor Xuanzong set up frontier commissioners—only then did Tang titles and ranks appear.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang, the Khitan first received commandery governors and prefects, then princely titles from Empress Wu, then frontier commissioners from Xuanzong—Tang office and rank had arrived.

sentences.zh: 其後習聞河北蕃鎮受唐官名，於是太師、太保、司徒、司空施於部族。

translations.literal: Afterward they grew accustomed to hearing that the Hebei frontier commands received Tang office names, and so Grand Preceptor, Grand Guardian, Grand Tutor, and Grand Commandant were applied within the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: They then heard how Hebei military governors took Tang titles, and Grand Preceptor, Grand Guardian, Grand Tutor, and Grand Commandant spread through the tribes.

translations.literal: Taizu followed this practice.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu adopted the same practice.

sentences.zh: 大同元年，世宗始置北院樞密使。

translations.literal: In Datong year 1, Shizong first established the Northern Court Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong created the Northern Court Privy Commissioner in Datong year 1.

sentences.zh: 明年，世宗以高勛為南院樞密，則樞密之設，蓋自太宗入汴始矣。

translations.literal: The next year Shizong appointed Gao Xun Southern Court privy commissioner; the establishment of the privy commission thus began when Taizong entered Bian.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Gao Xun became Southern privy commissioner—the privy posts date from Taizong's entry into Bian.

translations.literal: In Tianlu year 4 the Directorate of Governance was founded.
translations.idiomatic: Tianlu year 4 saw the Directorate of Governance established.

sentences.zh: 於是南面官僚可得而書。

translations.literal: Only then could Southern Face bureaucracy be set down in writing.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Face offices could then be recorded in full.

sentences.zh: 其始，漢人樞密院兼尚書省，吏、兵、刑有承旨，戶、工有主事，中書省兼禮部，別有戶部使司。

translations.literal: At first the Han Privy Council also held the Department of State Affairs: Personnel, War, and Justice had receivers; Revenue and Works had clerks; the Secretariat also held Rites, and there was a separate Revenue Commissioner Office.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Han Privy Council doubled as the Department of State Affairs—Personnel, War, and Justice had receivers, Revenue and Works had clerks, the Secretariat held Rites, and a separate Revenue Commissioner Office existed.

sentences.zh: 以營州之地加幽、冀之半，用是適足矣。

translations.literal: With Yingzhou territory added to half of You and Ji, that was just sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Adding Yingzhou to half of You and Ji made the arrangement adequate.

sentences.zh: 中葉彌文，耶律楊六為太傅，知有三師矣。

translations.literal: In the mid-reign titles multiplied: Yelu Yangliu as Grand Preceptor showed that the Three Preceptors existed.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-dynasty titles proliferated—Yelu Yangliu as Grand Preceptor revealed the Three Preceptors.

sentences.zh: 忽古質為太尉，知有三公矣。

translations.literal: Huguzhi as Grand Commandant showed that the Three Dukes existed.
translations.idiomatic: Huguzhi as Grand Commandant showed the Three Dukes were in place.

sentences.zh: 於斡古得為常侍，劉涇為禮部尚書，知有門下、尚書省矣。

translations.literal: Yuwangde as Regular Attendant and Liu Jing as Minister of Rites showed that the Gate and Ministries existed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwangde as Regular Attendant and Liu Jing as Minister of Rites showed Gate and Ministry institutions.

sentences.zh: 大理、司農有卿，國子、少府有監，九卿、列監見矣。

translations.idiomatic: Review and Granary had directors; Education and Palace Workshops had supervisors—the Nine Directors and supervisory offices appeared.

sentences.zh: 金吾、千牛有大將，十六列衛見矣。

sentences.zh: 太子上有師保，下有府率，東宮備官也。

translations.idiomatic: The Heir Apparent had preceptors and guardians above and commandery rates below—full Eastern Palace staff.

sentences.zh: 節度、觀察、防禦、團練、刺史，咸在方州，如唐制也。

translations.literal: Military commissioners, observation commissioners, defense commissioners, training commissioners, and prefects all stood in the provinces, as under Tang institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Military, observation, defense, and training commissioners and prefects sat in the provinces as in Tang.

translations.literal: Liao already had Northern Face palace offices; once it held the sixteen prefectures of Yan and Dai it adopted Tang institutions and re-established Southern Face Secretariat, Six Ministries, courts, academies, directorates, guards, and Eastern Palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: With Northern Face offices in place, seizing Yan and Dai's sixteen prefectures brought Tang institutions back—Southern Secretariat, Six Ministries, courts, academies, directorates, guards, and Eastern Palace posts.

sentences.zh: 誠有誌帝王之盛制，亦以招徠中國之人也。
